mirror_safe_rules.rule: Mirror-safe traits may follow the sprite mirror transform. Directional traits must define left/right hand or side-specific anchors before they can render on mirrored roles.

pose_adaptation_policy.master_mannequin: Design every trait first on side_front_point.
pose_adaptation_policy.propagation_rule: Adapt the same item to each active runtime sheet; do not create pose-specific clothing designs.
adaptation_steps: Keep the same visual item identity, colors, materials, and silhouette language.
Resize and reposition the item to the destination pose anchor.
Adjust rotation for body angle, facing direction, and limb position.
Use simplified placement for quick or rare poses when necessary.
Require stronger consistency on common/core poses than rare personality poses.

quality_floor.small_pose_policy: If a rare pose reads smaller, try runtime scale normalization first. If quality suffers, keep it rare-only and regenerate later only if consistency breaks.

fields.x: 0..1 center x inside the current sprite frame
fields.y: 0..1 center y inside the current sprite frame
fields.scale: relative scale multiplier for the trait artwork on this role
fields.rotation: degrees clockwise from the master trait orientation
fields.mirror_safe: whether the placement may use the sprite mirror transform

traits.name: Neon Borough Cap
traits.pose_adaptation_notes: Designed and approved on the actual side_front_point Moonbot, then fitted against every promoted runtime sheet. Front, right-profile, left-profile, and rear extractions preserve one cap identity. Every role stores measured 25-frame head centres, widths, tops, asset orientation, scale, and rotation data.
traits.notes: Complete production wearable propagation across every promoted runtime role. All fitted views originate from actual Moonbot frames; standalone concept renders are not runtime assets.

traits.name: Sample Lunar Cap
traits.pose_adaptation_notes: Master cap is designed on side_front_point, then resized onto the top/head anchor. Side roles use a simplified profile cap silhouette so the same cap identity survives the turn.
traits.notes: Head-item proof sample for hats, crowns, halo-like headwear, and helmet placement.

traits.name: Sample Visor Glasses
traits.pose_adaptation_notes: Master visor accent is centered on side_front_point. Side poses compress the bridge and keep the bright lens strip aligned to the visible eye/visor band.
traits.notes: Face-item proof sample for glasses, visor accents, and compact masks.

traits.name: Sample Chest Badge
traits.pose_adaptation_notes: Master badge is placed on the side_front_point chest. Side poses scale it down and keep it on the visible torso plate without inventing a new logo.
traits.notes: Chest-item proof sample for logo badges, hoodie marks, pins, and chain medallions.

traits.name: Sample Micro Jetpack
blocked_conditions: Mirrored side roles are blocked until left/right backpack or jetpack anchors are authored.
traits.pose_adaptation_notes: Master back item peeks from the far side of side_front_point. Side roles place the same jetpack on the rear torso anchor; mirrored draws are skipped unless a trait is explicitly mirror-safe.
traits.notes: Back-item proof sample for backpacks, wings, and small jetpacks.

traits.name: Sample Wrench Prop
blocked_conditions: Mirrored side roles are blocked until left/right hand anchors are authored.
traits.pose_adaptation_notes: Master wrench is aligned to the pointing hand on side_front_point. Wave/side roles simplify the hand contact point while preserving the same prop silhouette and colors.
traits.notes: Hand/prop proof sample for spray cans, tools, snacks, and controllers.

traits.name: Sample Electric Aura
traits.pose_adaptation_notes: Master aura surrounds side_front_point. Runtime scales the same outline around front and side poses and draws it behind the sprite as an effect layer.
traits.notes: Aura/effect proof sample for glow, sparks, and electric-outline traits.
